notes: Options turnover is premium value. Until early 2024 the file also carried an older table on notional value (Mutual Funds, Proprietory Trades, Others).
notes_published: 1.Data is categorised first on custodial participant code basis and if custodial participant code is not assigned, then as per client category codes as uploaded by trading members in UCC system.
2. ‘Retail’ includes HUF, Individual/Proprietorship Firms, NRI and Partnership Firm / Limited Liability Partnership.

3. ‘Others’ includes Public & Private Companies/Bodies Corporates, Trust / Society, Domestic Financial Institutions (Other than Banks & Insurance), Statutory Bodies, New Pension System (NPS), Non-Govt. Organisation, Depository Receipts, Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), Domestic Venture Capital Fund and PRO trades.
4. 'Options' turnover (Buy Value and Sell Value) is based on Premium value
